wikipediaSummary.title: Chronicle: The 20 Greatest Hits
wikipediaSummary.description: 1976 greatest hits album by Creedence Clearwater Revival
wikipediaSummary.extract: Chronicle, or fully Chronicle: The 20 Greatest Hits, is a greatest hits album by the American rock band Creedence Clearwater Revival. It was released in January 1976 by Fantasy Records. The edited version of "I Heard It Through the Grapevine" featured on the album was simultaneously released as a single.
